capabilities: Scan notes, properties, Canvas boards and bases for attachment references
List attachments with their locations, sizes and reference counts
Detect broken attachment links and suggest likely replacement files
Apply reviewed, single-link repairs that preserve link style and formatting
Undo the most recent repair, including after restarting Obsidian
disambiguation: Not an attachment organizer or cleaner; it never renames, moves or deletes attachment files, only repairs the links that point to them.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.14+); a mobile version is planned. Results are kept in memory and lost on restart unless auto-scan on open is enabled. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows no overview of where attachment files are referenced and offers no way to find or fix attachment links broken by files renamed or moved outside Obsidian.
summary: Reference scanner that lists every attachment's usage in the vault, finds broken attachment links, and repairs them one at a time after review.
